tests.title: Invariant 2: SearchIndex initialization creates FTS5 tables and operates as derived projection
tests.oracle: SQLite FTS5 virtual tables and metadata tables are created cleanly.

tests.title: Search result strictly includes mandatory source provenance fields (source_ref, watermark)
tests.setup: SearchIndex with indexed records and artifacts.
tests.oracle: Every returned SearchResult has valid source_ref, doc_type, score, and source_watermark.

tests.title: Exact and prefix keyword queries match records accurately
tests.action: Search with exact and prefix terms.
tests.oracle: Relevant records returned with rank scores reflecting match quality.

tests.title: Full index rebuild from authoritative CoreStore completely reconstructs search index
tests.setup: Populated CoreStore, wiped or empty search.db.
tests.oracle: All stream records are re-indexed; search results match pre-wipe index exactly.

tests.title: Artifact metadata and content snippets are searchable via FTS5
tests.setup: Indexed artifacts with JSON metadata and snippets.
tests.action: Search for terms present in artifact description or snippet.
tests.oracle: Artifact doc_type results returned with source_ref pointing to artifact:digest.

tests.title: Skill catalog items and tags are searchable via FTS5
tests.setup: Indexed skills with names, descriptions, and tags.
tests.action: Search for skill tags or functionality descriptions.
tests.oracle: Skill doc_type results returned with high relevance score.

tests.title: Filtering by doc_type ('record', 'artifact', 'skill') restricts results cleanly
tests.setup: Mixed documents (records, artifacts, skills) containing common keyword 'architecture'.
tests.oracle: Only skill documents are returned in results.

tests.title: Rebuild without valid authoritative store raises SearchIndexRebuildOrderError
tests.action: Attempt to call rebuild_from_sources with None or invalid store.
tests.oracle: Raises SearchIndexRebuildOrderError; Invariant 2 preserved.

tests.title: Malformed query syntax (special characters, unclosed quotes) handled safely without crash
tests.action: Search with syntax error queries (e.g., '"unclosed quote', 'AND OR NOT ***').
tests.oracle: Handled gracefully by query sanitizer; does not crash database connection.

tests.title: Corrupted search database triggers SearchIndexCorruptedError and clean recovery on clear()
tests.action: SearchIndex detects corruption on verify, raises SearchIndexCorruptedError, recovers on clear/rebuild.
tests.oracle: Corruption flagged; index reset restores normal operation.

tests.title: Clean lifecycle: closing and disabling search index leaves CoreStore and M2 untouched
tests.action: Close search index and append records to CoreStore.
tests.oracle: CoreStore functions with 100% fidelity independently of SearchIndex lifecycle.

tests.title: Zero dev-dependency violation: search index runs on standard library sqlite3 FTS5 (REL-009)
tests.oracle: Uses only standard library modules and internal public ports.

tests.title: Invariant 3: Memory operations are derived and never rewrite or mutate source records
tests.action: Propose, accept, and supersede memory items.
tests.oracle: Original records in CoreStore remain 100% byte-for-byte unchanged; direct rewrite raises MemorySourceRewriteForbiddenError.

tests.title: Memory items maintain mandatory source_ref linking to originating stream position or artifact
tests.setup: Proposed memory item from stream event.
tests.oracle: source_ref precisely references originating stream_id and position or artifact digest.

tests.title: Memory lifecycle: proposal, acceptance, and rejection follow CANDIDATE state machine
tests.oracle: First transitions to ACCEPTED; second transitions to REJECTED; unknown ID raises MemoryNotFoundError.

tests.title: Illegal state transitions on memory items raise MemoryStateTransitionError
tests.setup: Memory item in REJECTED or CANDIDATE state.
tests.action: Attempt illegal transitions (e.g. REJECTED -> ACCEPTED, CANDIDATE -> SUPERSEDED).
tests.oracle: Raises MemoryStateTransitionError.

tests.title: Invariant 4: Context Pack is strictly bounded by max_tokens budget with deterministic trimming
tests.setup: Multiple ACCEPTED memory items totalling 500 tokens.
tests.action: Build context pack with budget of 200 tokens.
tests.oracle: Resulting ContextPack has total_tokens <= 200; zero budget overflow.

tests.title: Zero or impossible budget raises ContextPackBudgetExceededError
tests.oracle: Raises ContextPackBudgetExceededError.

tests.title: Memory supersession links old memory to new and excludes old from active packs
tests.action: Accept memory item B and supersede A with B.
tests.oracle: Item A state is SUPERSEDED with superseded_by='B'; only item B appears in active context pack.

tests.title: Memory revocation transitions ACCEPTED memory to REVOKED and removes from active queries
tests.oracle: Item state becomes REVOKED; querying active memories excludes it.

tests.title: Replaying memory proposal events from stream records fully reconstructs memory store
tests.setup: Populated CoreStore with memory event records; wiped memory store.
tests.oracle: All memory items and their accepted/superseded states are reconstructed 100%.

tests.title: Query active memories filters by key_prefix and memory_type correctly
tests.setup: Mix of episodic and semantic memories under various key prefixes.
tests.oracle: Returns exact matching subset in ACCEPTED state.

tests.title: Disabling memory module leaves CoreStore and M2 operational with zero disruption
tests.action: Close MemoryStore and continue CoreStore transactions.
tests.oracle: CoreStore records and streams function completely independently.

tests.title: Zero dev-dependency violation: memory module runs on standard library (REL-009)
tests.oracle: Uses only standard library modules and internal public ports.

tests.title: Invariant 7: Routing selects candidate peer without executing work or invoking external side effects
tests.setup: Router instance with work request and candidate peers.
tests.oracle: Returns RouteDecision with selected peer; zero task dispatch or side-effect execution triggered.

tests.title: Attempting execution from Router raises RoutingExecutionAttemptForbiddenError
tests.action: Attempt to call execute_decision or bypass selector.
tests.oracle: Raises RoutingExecutionAttemptForbiddenError.

tests.title: Deterministic decision replay produces identical candidate ranking and decision digest
tests.oracle: Both invocations produce identical selected_peer_id, candidate scores, and decision_digest.

tests.title: RoutePolicy revision change alters decision digest and reflects new weights deterministically
tests.setup: Candidate set with differing latency vs eval_score profiles.
tests.action: Evaluate under Policy v1 (latency-focused) and Policy v2 (eval-focused).
tests.oracle: Decisions differ according to policy weights; policy_revision is recorded in decision.

tests.title: Invariant 8: UNKNOWN health evidence causes disqualification in default fail-safe policy
tests.oracle: Candidate is disqualified with rejection_reason='UNKNOWN_HEALTH_REJECTED'.

tests.title: Invariant 8: UNKNOWN quota evidence is never treated as unlimited quota
tests.oracle: Candidate receives zero quota bonus and is disqualified if quota evidence required.

tests.title: Candidate breakdown includes capability matching, score calculation, and rank order
tests.setup: 3 candidate peers with varying capability coverage.
tests.oracle: Evaluations contain rank 1, 2, 3 ordered by composite_score, with missing capabilities flagged.

tests.title: Tie-break ordering is deterministic based on lexicographical peer_id
tests.setup: Two candidates with identical scores and capabilities ('peer:beta', 'peer:alpha').
tests.oracle: 'peer:alpha' selected first deterministically via tie-break.

tests.title: No eligible candidate raises NoEligibleRouteCandidateError
tests.setup: Candidates missing required capabilities or UNHEALTHY.
tests.oracle: Raises NoEligibleRouteCandidateError with detailed rejection breakdown.

tests.title: Empty candidates list raises NoEligibleRouteCandidateError cleanly
tests.oracle: Raises NoEligibleRouteCandidateError without unhandled exception.

tests.title: Router operates as stateless pure functional selector without storage coupling
tests.setup: Router instance without persistent storage handle.
tests.oracle: Operates statelessly; does not require or mutate database tables.

tests.title: Zero dev-dependency violation: routing engine runs on standard library (REL-009)
tests.oracle: Module uses only standard library packages.
